Description.WithoutCard: When combat starts or this card gets discarded, it gets put into the <c=keyword>ability pile</c> and gains <c=cardtrait>Cooldown</c>.
Description.WithCard: When combat starts or this card gets discarded, it gets put into the <c=keyword>ability pile</c> and gains <c=cardtrait>Cooldown {{Amount}}</c>.

Description.WithoutCard: Decreases each turn by 1. When any <c=cardtrait>ability</c> reaches <c=cardtrait>Cooldown 0</c>, put <c=card>Abilities</c> in your hand.
Description.WithCard: Decreases each turn by 1. When any <c=cardtrait>ability</c> reaches <c=cardtrait>Cooldown 0</c>, put <c=card>Abilities</c> in your hand.

FullAuto.Name: Full Auto
FullAuto.Description: After playing this card for the first time each turn, it gets <c=cardtrait>discounted</c> by 1.

Description.WithoutCard: Deals more damage if retained last turn.
Description.WithCard: Deals <c=boldPink>{{Amount}}</c> more damage if retained last turn.

AutoLoadingHolster.Name: Auto-Loading Holster
AutoLoadingHolster.Description: When drawn, gain 1 <c=status>AMMO</c> of this card's cost.

Description.Stateless: Costs 1 less <c=status>AMMO</c> or <c=energy>ENERGY</c>, <c=downside>but deals 1 less damage</c>.

CompulsiveReloader.Name: Compulsive Reloader
CompulsiveReloader.Description: Costs 1 less <c=energy>ENERGY</c> if its <c=status>AMMO</c> is full.

Demoralize.Name: Demoralize
Demoralize.Description: Once per combat, hitting a <c=parttrait>weak</c>/<c=parttrait>brittle</c> part makes a part next to it also <c=parttrait>weak</c>/<c=parttrait>brittle</c>, preferring left.

EnviousArsenal.Name: Envious Arsenal
EnviousArsenal.Description: While in hand, playing another <c=cardtrait>Weapon</c> <c=cardtrait>discounts</c> this card by 1.

Frenzy.Name: Frenzy
Frenzy.Description: Deals 1 more damage if you dealt any damage last turn.

Headstone.Name: Headstone
Headstone.Description: Once per turn, after hitting a <c=parttrait>weak</c>/<c=parttrait>brittle</c> part, create a <c=midrow>Geode</c> in front of it.

HealClip.Name: Heal Clip
HealClip.Description: If you end your turn with more than 0 <c=energy>ENERGY</c> after playing this card this turn, <c=heal>heal</c> 1.

Quickdraw.Name: Quickdraw
Quickdraw.Description: Costs 1 less <c=energy>ENERGY</c> if played first in a turn.

Rampage.Name: Rampage
Rampage.Description: Deals 1 more damage for each time this card was played this turn.

RepulsorBrace.Name: Repulsor Brace
RepulsorBrace.Description: Once per turn, playing this card gives you 1 <c=status>temp shield</c>.

Rimestealer.Name: Rimestealer
Rimestealer.Description: Gain 1 <c=status>temp shield</c> when a <c=midrow>Geode</c> is destroyed with this card.

Surrounded.Name: Surrounded
Surrounded.Description: Deals 1 more damage while the ships fully overlap.

Abilities.Name: Abilities
Abilities.Description: Choose an <c=cardtrait>ability</c> with <c=cardtrait>Cooldown 0</c>. Put it in hand.

SearchAction.Title: Ability Pile: {{Count}} Cards
SearchAction.Description: Choose a card from your <c=keyword>ability pile</c>.
